notes: Validation establishes internal referential/methodological integrity of the proposal only. It does not establish source authority, canonical identity, or accepted coverage.
regression_cases: Baseline Picard occurrence and Confederation-role Picard remain separate local entities; Q's synthetic-body statement stays testimony rather than global body fact.
Seven and President Annika remain separate local occurrences; changed Borg-marker/body history does not produce an automatic global identity merge.
The Confederation Borg Queen, 2024 physical Queen, Jurati-Queen neural-link state, and later Queen mental presence remain distinct local occurrences/states.
Jurati's neural-link/mental entwinement with the Queen is represented as contested agency/identity boundary rather than a binary merger.
Watcher temporary host body and Tallinn remain distinct; Tallinn/Laris resemblance is evidence of resemblance only, not SAME_AS.
Elnor's depicted death and the possibility of temporal restoration remain separate propositions, with restoration explicitly unresolved.
Renée Picard's Europa mission as the temporal hinge remains a participant hypothesis with incomplete causal mechanism.
